cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: No Tie Stands
cards.instruction: Turn every even outcome into a formal rematch with a new rule and a consequence for losing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We split the dinner bill exactly. Toss a coin; loser pays the tip.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You choose heads or tails. I'll find the coin; we need a tiebreak.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Rate the meal out of ten, then. Lower score pays the tip. Equal scores mean best of three tosses.

reason: Use a grounded tip consequence instead of an unexplained waiter apology; A adapts B equal-enjoyment claim into a rated rematch with a tie rule.
